evidence: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis revealed stoichiometric Ga2O3 thin films with no detectable carbon contamination. The refractive index of the Ga2O3 films was determined from spectroscopic ellipsometry measurements and found to be 1.84 at a wavelength of 632.8 nm. The thickness of the growing Ga2O3 films was monitored in situ using spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE, J. A. Woollam M2000). The determination of film thickness by in situ SE was complemented by ex situ X-ray reflectivity (XRR) measurements. X-ray fluorescence (XRF) measurements were performed using a Mo X-ray source... The film crystallinity was investigated by X-ray diffraction (Bruker D8 Discover, Cu Kα radiation). The surface roughness of the films was determined by atomic force microscopy (AFM) on a Bruker Dimension Edge system... The ALD process was characterized by in situ quadrupole mass spectrometry (QMS, Hiden Analytical) using the spectrometer in Multiple Ion Detection (MID) mode...
